text:
Alex: Heads-up — Sentinel (customer) VPC deploy tomorrow 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need final signoffs + rollback plan.
Maria: What's the deploy owner? Can we run smoke tests in the staging VPC beforehand? @Sam?
ops-bot: Scheduled window reserved: Sentinel - Private VPC - 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC
Sam: I'll own the deploy and be oncall for the window. Planning to start provisioning at 01:30 UTC for last-minute checks.
Jin: Quick checklist:
- Confirm route53 records update window
- KV cache flush plan
- Model variants pinned for degraded mode
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 1200ms after cutover
DevX: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/sentinel/deploy/PR-482 please lgtm if you reviewed
Maria: Smoke steps (run at 01:50 UTC against staging):
```
# smoke checklist
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.sentinel.redwood.ai/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'
python tools/check_stream_latency.py --endpoint https://staging.sentinel.redwood.ai/stream --samples 10
kubectl -n sentinel get pods | grep inference
```
Sam: Rollback plan in case of failure:
1) Repoint traffic to stable routing policy (runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/sentinel/rollback)
2) Scale down new replicas: `kubectl -n sentinel scale deployment sentinel-infer --replicas=0`
3) Restore KV state from snapshot `kvctl restore --from=sentinel-predeploy-20260321`
I'll have rollback scripts ready in /ops/sentinel/rollback.sh
Leo: I'll monitor metrics and can watch p95/p99, error rate. Pager oncall is @infra-oncall
Alex: Need Acks: @Maria @Jin @DevX @Leo. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can join at 01:45 UTC signal-check call.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll be on the call and will run smoke checks.
Jin: :thumbsup: running load sim and latency probe.
DevX: lgtm on PR-482, leaving a minor comment. Will be reachable.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 1h before window: Sentinel deploy at 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC
Sam: noted. I'll post a runbook snapshot 30m before start.
Alex: Thanks — we'll do a quick preflight channel check by 01:40 UTC. If anything blocks, escalate in this thread.
